data.description: Used for phishing. For example a phishing site or a email sender address sending phishing emails.
Used for payload delivery. For example a URL hosting malware, or a email sender
Used for social engineering. For example fake or spoofed email sender addresses, or domains used for typosquatting.
Used for data leaks. For example a URL hosting leaked data.
Used for proxy. For example a domain hosting a proxy server.
Used as attacker infrastructure. For example an IP launching DDoS attacks.
Used for exfiltration. For example a domain where stolen data is exfiltrated to.
Used for email infrastructure. For example a domain used as a mail server.
Remote desktop software. For example IPs of ScreenConnect instance.
Services used to lookup IP or geolocation information, mostly benign services.
Compromised service such as hacked websites.
Services used for tracking. For example, analytics trackers. Often benign.
